"""Invoice number formatting."""

import re

_BRANCH = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]{2,4}")


def luhn_check_digit(digits: str) -> int:
    """Return the Luhn check digit to append to the digit string ``digits``.

    Starting from the rightmost digit of ``digits`` and moving left, every
    other digit is doubled, beginning with the rightmost digit itself; 9 is
    subtracted from any doubled value above 9. All resulting values are
    added up, and the check digit is ``(10 - total % 10) % 10``.
    """
    total = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
        n = int(ch)
        if i % 2 == 1:
            n *= 2
            if n > 9:
                n -= 9
        total += n
    return (10 - total % 10) % 10


def format_invoice_number(branch: str, year: int, sequence: int) -> str:
    """Return the display number of an invoice.

    The format is ``BRANCH-YYYY-NNNNNN-C``:

    * ``BRANCH`` is ``branch`` with surrounding whitespace removed and
      upper-cased; it must then consist of 2 to 4 ASCII letters.
    * ``YYYY`` is ``year``, which must be between 1000 and 9999.
    * ``NNNNNN`` is ``sequence`` zero-padded to six digits; ``sequence`` must
      be between 1 and 999999.
    * ``C`` is the Luhn check digit of the ten digits ``YYYY`` + ``NNNNNN``
      (see ``luhn_check_digit``).

    Invalid input raises ``ValueError``.
    """
    code = branch.strip()
    if not _BRANCH.fullmatch(code):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid branch code: {branch!r}")
    if not 1000 <= year <= 9999:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid year: {year}")
    if not 1 <= sequence <= 999999:
        raise ValueError(f"sequence out of range: {sequence}")
    payload = f"{year:04d}{sequence:06d}"
    return f"{code}-{year:04d}-{sequence:06d}-{luhn_check_digit(payload)}"

"""Invoice number formatting."""

import re

_BRANCH = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]{2,4}")


def luhn_check_digit(digits: str) -> int:
    """Return the Luhn check digit to append to the digit string ``digits``.

    Starting from the rightmost digit of ``digits`` and moving left, every
    other digit is doubled, beginning with the rightmost digit itself; 9 is
    subtracted from any doubled value above 9. All resulting values are
    added up, and the check digit is ``(10 - total % 10) % 10``.
    """
    total = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
        n = int(ch)
        if i % 2 == 0:
            n *= 2
            if n > 9:
                n -= 9
        total += n
    return (10 - total % 10) % 10


def format_invoice_number(branch: str, year: int, sequence: int) -> str:
    """Return the display number of an invoice.

    The format is ``BRANCH-YYYY-NNNNNN-C``:

    * ``BRANCH`` is ``branch`` with surrounding whitespace removed and
      upper-cased; it must then consist of 2 to 4 ASCII letters.
    * ``YYYY`` is ``year``, which must be between 1000 and 9999.
    * ``NNNNNN`` is ``sequence`` zero-padded to six digits; ``sequence`` must
      be between 1 and 999999.
    * ``C`` is the Luhn check digit of the ten digits ``YYYY`` + ``NNNNNN``
      (see ``luhn_check_digit``).

    Invalid input raises ``ValueError``.
    """
    code = branch.strip().upper()
    if not _BRANCH.fullmatch(code):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid branch code: {branch!r}")
    if not 1000 <= year <= 9999:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid year: {year}")
    if not 1 <= sequence <= 999999:
        raise ValueError(f"sequence out of range: {sequence}")
    payload = f"{year:04d}{sequence:06d}"
    return f"{code}-{year:04d}-{sequence:06d}-{luhn_check_digit(payload)}"

8	def luhn_check_digit(digits: str) -> int:
9	    """Return the Luhn check digit to append to the digit string ``digits``.
10	
11	    Starting from the rightmost digit of ``digits`` and moving left, every
12	    other digit is doubled, beginning with the rightmost digit itself; 9 is
13	    subtracted from any doubled value above 9. All resulting values are
14	    added up, and the check digit is ``(10 - total % 10) % 10``.
15	    """
16	    total = 0
17	    for i, ch in enumerate(reversed(digits)):
18	        n = int(ch)
19	        if i % 2 == 0:
20	            n *= 2
21	            if n > 9:
22	                n -= 9
23	        total += n
24	    return (10 - total % 10) % 10

27	def format_invoice_number(branch: str, year: int, sequence: int) -> str:
28	    """Return the display number of an invoice.
29	
30	    The format is ``BRANCH-YYYY-NNNNNN-C``:
31	
32	    * ``BRANCH`` is ``branch`` with surrounding whitespace removed and
33	      upper-cased; it must then consist of 2 to 4 ASCII letters.
34	    * ``YYYY`` is ``year``, which must be between 1000 and 9999.
35	    * ``NNNNNN`` is ``sequence`` zero-padded to six digits; ``sequence`` must
36	      be between 1 and 999999.
37	    * ``C`` is the Luhn check digit of the ten digits ``YYYY`` + ``NNNNNN``
38	      (see ``luhn_check_digit``).
39	
40	    Invalid input raises ``ValueError``.
41	    """
42	    code = branch.strip().upper()
43	    if not _BRANCH.fullmatch(code):
44	        raise ValueError(f"invalid branch code: {branch!r}")
45	    if not 1000 <= year <= 9999:
46	        raise ValueError(f"invalid year: {year}")
47	    if not 1 <= sequence <= 999999:
48	        raise ValueError(f"sequence out of range: {sequence}")
49	    payload = f"{year:04d}{sequence:06d}"
50	    return f"{code}-{year:04d}-{sequence:06d}-{luhn_check_digit(payload)}"
